keyword.zh: 电动10和电动15混凝土泵的区别

title.en: Electric 10 vs Electric 15 at the Same 15 kW
title.zh: 同为15千瓦时，电动10和电动15有何不同

description.en: Both compact electric pumps print a 15 kW motor. Output, pressure, distance and pipe are not the same cells.
description.zh: 两台紧凑电动泵都印 15 kW 电机。产量、压力、距离和管径不是同一格。

h1.en: Electric 10 vs Electric 15 at the Same 15 kW
h1.zh: 同为15千瓦时，电动10和电动15有何不同

directAnswer.en: Electric 10 Series and Electric 15 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai that both print a 15 kW motor. Electric 10 prints 21 m³/h, 23 MPa and 25 m horizontal with no vertical line. Electric 15 prints 8–10 m³/h, 15–20 m vertical, 60–80 m horizontal and a 100–125 mm pipe, and it prints no outlet pressure.
directAnswer.zh: 电动10系列和电动15是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵，电机都印 15 kW。电动10印 21 m³/h、23 MPa、水平 25 m，没有垂直行。电动15印 8–10 m³/h、垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m、管内径 100–125 mm，并且不印出口压力。

heading.en: Where Electric 10 Series and Electric 15 print different values
heading.zh: 电动10系列和电动15哪些数值不同

body.en: Theoretical output: Electric 10 Series prints 21 m³/h; Electric 15 prints 8–10 m³/h. Max. aggregate size: Electric 10 Series prints 2 cm and below; Electric 15 prints 1–3 cm. Dimensions: Electric 10 Series prints 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm; Electric 15 prints 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm. The same printed value on a shared label: Motor power is 15 kW on both pages. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 理论输送量：电动10系列印 21 m³/h；电动15印 8–10 m³/h。最大骨料粒径：电动10系列印 2 cm and below；电动15印 1–3 cm。外形尺寸：电动10系列印 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm；电动15印 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm。同一标题下数值相同的有：电机功率两边都是 15 kW。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Electric 10 Series prints cells that Electric 15 does not: Max. outlet pressure 23 MPa; Hopper capacity 0.1 m³; Horizontal pumping distance 25 m; Main unit weight 400 kg. Electric 15 prints cells that Electric 10 Series does not: Vertical delivery height 15–20 m; Horizontal delivery distance 60–80 m; Delivery pipe diameter 100–125 mm; Total weight 450 kg. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 电动10系列有、电动15没有的行：最大出口压力 23 MPa；料斗容积 0.1 m³；水平输送距离 25 m；整机重量 400 kg。电动15有、电动10系列没有的行：垂直输送高度 15–20 m；水平输送距离 60–80 m；输送管内径 100–125 mm；整机重量 450 kg。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: Equal motor kilowatts do not equal the same output or the same distance layout. Open /en/products/electric-10-series-concrete-pump/ for Electric 10 Series and /en/products/electric-15-concrete-pump/ for Electric 15. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 电机千瓦数相同，不等于产量相同，也不等于距离的写法相同。看电动10系列请打开 /zh/products/electric-10-series-concrete-pump/，看电动15请打开 /zh/products/electric-15-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric 10 Series print the same theoretical output as Electric 15?
question.zh: 电动10系列和电动15的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 10 Series prints 21 m³/h. Electric 15 prints 8–10 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动10系列印 21 m³/h。电动15印 8–10 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 10 Series print the same max. aggregate size as Electric 15?
question.zh: 电动10系列和电动15的最大骨料粒径一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 10 Series prints 2 cm and below. Electric 15 prints 1–3 cm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动10系列印 2 cm and below。电动15印 1–3 cm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 10 Series print the same dimensions as Electric 15?
question.zh: 电动10系列和电动15的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 10 Series prints 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm. Electric 15 prints 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动10系列印 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm。电动15印 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is max. outlet pressure missing on Electric 15?
question.zh: 为什么电动15没有最大出口压力？

answer.en: The Electric 15 page does not print that label. Electric 10 Series prints 23 MPa. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 电动15这一页没有印这个标题。电动10系列印的是 23 MPa。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
